selection.note: The source-alignment requirement, anti-zombie interpretation, and possible outcomes were committed before this run completed. The sample was not selected after seeing its result.

source_alignment.note: The same current-main SHA was observed before and after the live-check window, and every declared material input matched it.

deterministic_deadlines_if_no_event_chan.note: Deadlines preserve Newsletter's strict age > threshold semantics by placing Proof Spine's inclusive valid_until transition one microsecond after the local threshold. New Stories, Airlocks, deploys, health receipts, or main changes are event-driven reasons to reevaluate earlier.

expected_shadow_outcome_under_current_v0.note: The exact public receipt executed and source alignment is directly attested. The private Hub consumer itself still lacks exact-head execution evidence in the available private runner environment, so its decision is recorded as a deterministic derivation rather than an executed decision receipt.

evidence_value.note: This is the first prospective sample that satisfies the hardened source-applicability requirement. It demonstrates that a healthy, current-aligned Newsletter observation need not be rejected merely because the unrelated candidate branch is UNKNOWN. It does not yet demonstrate unique sensitivity beyond existing local health machinery.

claim_boundary: Sample 002 proves that the hardened public evidence producer actually ran, observed a stable current-main source basis before and after its check window, and produced an aligned healthy receipt with exact artifact/content identities. It does not prove private exact-head consumer execution, shared-infrastructure promotion, or unique sensitivity beyond Newsletter's existing checks.
